title: Main physical features in Kenya
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Social Studies; not yet checked by a CBC Social Studies teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Use a relief map of Kenya. Facts: Mount Kenya is Kenya's highest mountain; Kilimanjaro is in Tanzania; the Rift Valley runs north to south; the Tana is Kenya's longest river.

skills.key_step: The child names Kenya's main physical features and says what kind each is (mountain, lake, river, valley, ocean).

floor.prerequisite: Tells a mountain, lake, river and valley apart.
floor.question: What is water with land all around it?

steps: Add one fact: highest, longest, shared.

board.do: Write Mount Kenya, Lake Turkana, Tana, Rift Valley.

board.say: What kind of feature is the Tana?

misconceptions.ask: What is the highest mountain in Kenya?
misconceptions.repair: Show that Kilimanjaro stands on the Tanzanian side. Ask which mountain gave Kenya its name.

misconceptions.ask: What kind of feature is Lake Turkana?
misconceptions.repair: Use the word in the name: lake or mount. Ask whether the water flows or stands.
On the map, shade the parts of the lake in each country: Kenya has the smallest part.

misconceptions.ask: Into which water body does the Tana River flow?
misconceptions.repair: Trace the Tana on the map from the highlands down to the coast.

checks.question: What kind of feature is the Great Rift Valley?

skills.key_step: The child places Kenya's main features on a described map: Lake Victoria west, Lake Turkana north-west, Mount Kenya centre, the coast south-east, the Rift Valley running north to south.
steps: Place the big water first: the lake in the west and the ocean on the south-east.
Place Mount Kenya in the centre.
Draw the Rift Valley from north to south.
contexts: a trip from Nairobi to Kisumu dropping into the Rift Valley
a fishing camp on Lake Turkana

board.do: Draw the Rift Valley as two lines from top to bottom.
Ask which direction the valley runs.

misconceptions.ask: In which part of Kenya is Lake Victoria?
misconceptions.repair: Link the feature to a neighbour: Lake Victoria is shared with Uganda and Tanzania, so it is on the west.

misconceptions.ask: In which direction does the Great Rift Valley run through Kenya?
misconceptions.repair: Describe the Rift lakes in order: Turkana in the north, then Baringo, Nakuru, Naivasha, Magadi toward the south.

listen_for: In central Kenya near Mount Kenya
misconceptions.repair: Put both on the map: one in the middle, one on the western border.

misconceptions.ask: In which part of Kenya is the coast?
misconceptions.repair: Trace the coast on the map and name the direction from Nairobi.

checks.question: In which part of Kenya is Lake Turkana?
Does the Great Rift Valley run from east to west or north to south?
